﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شِقاقِي﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يُصِيبَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of يجرمنكم. ﴿مِثْلُ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَصابَ﴾ a past verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صالِحٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ its noun. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بعيد. ﴿بِبَعِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and بعيد is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ﴾ the two khabars of inna, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ an imperative verb [Translator's note: so in the source; قالوا is a past verb] and its fāʿil. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿شُعَيْبُ﴾ the one addressed, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿نَفْقَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative with a latent fāʿil. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفقه. ﴿تَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَنَراكَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِينا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضعيفا. ﴿ضَعِيفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; if نرى is visual, ضعيفا is a ḥāl; if it is of knowledge, it is the second mafʿūl bihi]. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lawlā is a particle of non-occurrence owing to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). ﴿رَهْطُكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the khabar is omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَرَجَمْناكَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of lawlā, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عزيز. ﴿بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and عزيز is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed, accusative, the sign of its accusative being an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَرَهْطِي﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and رهطي is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعَزُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعز. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعز. ﴿وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَراءَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to اتخذتموه, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ظِهْرِيًّا﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is a causal explanation. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to محيط. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مُحِيطٌ﴾ the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:93-96.t:
﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl). ﴿عامِلٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَوْفَ﴾ for deferment (taswīf). ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَأْتِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿يُخْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is relative, conjoined to the first man. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كاذِبٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَارْتَقِبُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to رقيب, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَقِيبٌ﴾ khabar.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا شُعَيْباً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is conjoined to شعيبا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to نجينا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of رحمة. ﴿وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and a relative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and aṣbaḥa and its noun. ﴿فِي دِيارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاثمين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جاثِمِينَ﴾ khabar. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from kaʾanna, its noun omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَغْنَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of kaʾan. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يغنوا. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿لِمَدْيَنَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival); mā and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted adjective of بعد. ﴿بَعِدَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿ثَمُودُ﴾ the fāʿil of بعدت.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا مُوسى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا. ﴿وَسُلْطانٍ﴾ conjoined to آياتنا. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:97-100.t:
﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ فرعون is a diptote, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾ conjoined to فرعون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ the noun of mā [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ with fatḥa; as the noun of mā it is أَمْرُ, nominative]. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿بِرَشِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and رشيد is the khabar (predicate), genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يقدم. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil. ﴿النَّارَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿الْوِرْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمَوْرُودُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا [Translator's note: so in the source; the demonstrative here is ذه] is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتبعوا. ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and يوم is an adverb of time attached to أتبعوا. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِئْسَ﴾ a past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الرِّفْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمَرْفُودُ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَقُصُّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a second khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقصه. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿قائِمٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَحَصِيدٌ﴾ conjoined to قائم, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:101-105.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿ظَلَمْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿أَغْنَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أغنت. ﴿آلِهَتُهُمُ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of آلهتهم. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ al-ḥīniyya ("when"), an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿زادُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَتْبِيبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَخْذُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَخْذُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَخْذُ﴾ here; the word in the verse is the verb أَخَذَ]. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَهِيَ ظالِمَةٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ﴾ inna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and أليم is the first khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿شَدِيدٌ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ﴾ inna, and the demonstrative is genitive by fī; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the postponed noun of inna. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آية. ﴿خافَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ذلِكَ يَوْمٌ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ and يوم is khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَجْمُوعٌ﴾ an adjective of يوم. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مجموع. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of مجموع. ﴿وَذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿يَوْمٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مَشْهُودٌ﴾ an adjective of يوم, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes.

﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿نُؤَخِّرُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِأَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نؤخره. ﴿مَعْدُودٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يأتي. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql) [the yāʾ being dropped in the script], and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا تَكَلَّمُ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been dropped, nominative. ﴿نَفْسٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿شَقِيٌّ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَسَعِيدٌ﴾ conjoined to شقي.

daas-irab:106-108.t:
﴿فَأَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and ammā is a particle of detailing (tafṣīl) and condition. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شَقُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَفِي النَّارِ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the answer of lammā [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʾ is in the answer of ammā], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of الذين. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿زَفِيرٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَشَهِيقٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿خالِدِينَ فِيها﴾ ḥāl, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خالدين. ﴿ما دامَتِ السَّماواتُ﴾ mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and دامت is a complete (tāmm) past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and السماوات is the fāʿil. ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾ conjoined to السماوات. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative, excepted (mustathnā) by illā. ﴿شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فعال. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila.

﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ﴾ conjoined to فأما الذين شقوا etc., and parsed like it. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فِيها ما دامَتِ السَّماواتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا ما شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ its parsing has preceded. ﴿عَطاءً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أعطوا عطاء". ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عطاء. ﴿مَجْذُوذٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:109-110.t:
﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā, its noun omitted. ﴿فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مرية. ﴿يَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and أولاء is a demonstrative, fāʿil (agent). ﴿ما يَعْبُدُونَ﴾ mā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of the prohibition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "إلا عبادة مثل". ﴿يَعْبُدُ آباؤُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna, with the nā assimilated into it as its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and موفوهم is its khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَصِيبَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar موفوهم [Translator's note: so in the source; موفّو is an active participle, not a maṣdar], and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿مَنْقُوصٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُوسَى﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَاخْتُلِفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a passive past verb. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَلَوْلا كَلِمَةٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lawlā is a non-jussive-governing conditional particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted. ﴿سَبَقَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is an adjective of كلمة. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سبقت, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقُضِيَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of lawlā, and a passive past verb. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the answer of lawlā, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ﴾ the shifted lām, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شك. ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ an adjective of شك, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:111-113.t:
﴿وَإِنَّ كُلًّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and mā is relative, the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ postponed fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of يوفينهم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خبير. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of inna.

﴿فَاسْتَقِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿أُمِرْتَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the kāf and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya), and man is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿تابَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to تاب, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَطْغَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and mā is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بصير. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾ khabar.

﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَرْكَنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ الذين is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تركنوا. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّارُ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and mā is negating. ﴿لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both [prepositional phrases] are attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تُنْصَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:114-116.t:
﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿طَرَفَيِ﴾ an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقم. ﴿النَّهارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَزُلَفاً﴾ conjoined to طرفي. ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زلفا. ﴿إِنَّ الْحَسَناتِ﴾ inna and its noun, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿يُذْهِبْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿لِلذَّاكِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذكرى. ﴿وَاصْبِرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يُضِيعُ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

﴿فَلَوْلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lawlā is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولُوا﴾ the noun of kāna, nominative by the wāw because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿بَقِيَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَنْهَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿عَنِ الْفَسادِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينهون. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الفساد. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by illā. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of قليلا. ﴿أَنْجَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنجينا. ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ﴾ a past verb, and its clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُتْرِفُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أترفوا. ﴿وَكانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, which is accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:117-120.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿كانَ رَبُّكَ﴾ kāna and its noun; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيُهْلِكَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an; the kāf is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no kāf in يهلك, and القرى is its only object]. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِظُلْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يهلك; an and what follows it are attached to the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿وَأَهْلُها مُصْلِحُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and law is a non-jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of law, and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَلا يَزالُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مُخْتَلِفِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative by exception. ﴿رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلِذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the lām; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خلقهم. ﴿خَلَقَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and كلمة is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أملأن. ﴿وَالنَّاسِ﴾ conjoined to الجنة. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ.

﴿وَكُلًّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and كلا is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَقُصُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقص. ﴿الرُّسُلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُثَبِّتُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) with a latent fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نثبت. ﴿فُؤادَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجاءَكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ ذا [Translator's note: so in the source; the demonstrative here is ذه] is a demonstrative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءك. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿وَمَوْعِظَةٌ﴾ conjoined to الحق. ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾ conjoined to what precedes; it is nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذكرى.

daas-irab:121-123.t: ﴿وَقُلْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اعملوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna, and nā is its noun. ﴿عامِلُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿غَيْبُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السماوات. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرجع. ﴿يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and الأمر is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿كُلُّهُ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَاعْبُدْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and it is conjoined to اعبده. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توكل. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and غافل is the khabar of mā, genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ ʿan is a preposition and mā is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿الر﴾: letters with no grammatical position. ﴿كِتابٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هذا كتاب" ("this is a Book"). ﴿أُحْكِمَتْ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿آياتُهُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿فُصِّلَتْ﴾: conjoined to أحكمت. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحكمت. ﴿حَكِيمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَبِيرٍ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿أَلَّا﴾: the subjunctive-governing an, and lā is negating. ﴿تَعْبُدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَلَّا﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word here is إِلَّا]: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّنِي﴾: inna and its noun; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾: the khabar of إني. ﴿وَبَشِيرٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on نذير; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an is conjoined to the an in His saying, Exalted is He, ألا تعبدوا. ﴿اسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تُوبُوا﴾: conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توبوا. ﴿يُمَتِّعْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَتاعاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾: an adjective. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يمتعكم. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾: an adjective of أجل, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿وَيُؤْتِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb conjoined to يمتعكم; it is jussive like it, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَضْلَهُ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنِ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is وَإِنْ]: the wāw is resumptive and what follows it is resumptive speech; in is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَإِنِّي﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna and its noun; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَخافُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخاف. ﴿عَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَبِيرٍ﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:4-6.t: ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate), and مرجعكم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هو is a mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَثْنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿صُدُورَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيَسْتَخْفُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of cause, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the lām and what follows it are attached to يثنون. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يثنون. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of drawing attention. ﴿حِينَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to يعلم. ﴿يَسْتَغْشُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثِيابَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما يُسِرُّونَ﴾: mā is relative, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُسِرُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿رِزْقُها﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of دابة. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مُسْتَقَرَّها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمُسْتَوْدَعَها﴾: conjoined to مستقرها. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب. Beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it contains the sense of generality, i.e. "all of that is in a Book".

daas-irab:7-8.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾: a past verb and its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on السموات. ﴿فِي سِتَّةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانَ عَرْشُهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَى الْماءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of cause; the kāf is its first object and the fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to خلق. ﴿أَيُّكُمْ﴾: أيّ is a mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحْسَنُ﴾: khabar. ﴿عَمَلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يبلوكم. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿قُلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَبْعُوثُونَ﴾: the khabar of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مبعوثون. ﴿الْمَوْتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَيَقُولَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the nūn is a particle with no grammatical position; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an omitted oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿سِحْرٌ﴾: the khabar of هذا. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and what follows it is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَخَّرْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْهُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرنا. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial. ﴿إِلى أُمَّةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخرنا. ﴿مَعْدُودَةٍ﴾: an adjective. ﴿لَيَقُولُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative; the nūn has been dropped because of dislike of a succession of identical letters, and the wāw of the plural, which is the fāʿil, has been dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, the ḍamma indicating it. The verb is not made indeclinable on the fatḥa through being joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis because the wāw of the plural separates it from the verb. The clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath, and the apodosis is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَحْبِسُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its object and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar, and the clause ما يحبسه is the object of the saying. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ), and what follows it is resumptive speech. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to مصروفا. ﴿يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the hāʾ is its object and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿مَصْرُوفاً﴾: the khabar of laysa. ﴿عَنْهُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مصروفا. ﴿وَحاقَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حاق. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:9-11.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: it has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿أَذَقْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْإِنْسانَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَّا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿نَزَعْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لَيَؤُسٌ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), joined to the khabar (predicate) of inna, which is nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿كَفُورٌ﴾: a second khabar. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿أَذَقْناهُ نَعْماءَ﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿ضَرَّاءَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿مَسَّتْهُ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لَيَقُولَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis; the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the oath indicates it. ﴿ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئاتُ عَنِّي﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its two khabars, with the shifted lām. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: excepted (mustathnā). ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَجْرٌ﴾: maʿṭūf on مغفرة. ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾: an adjective; the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:12-15.t: ﴿فَلَعَلَّكَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and laʿalla and its noun. ﴿تارِكٌ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَعْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تارك. ﴿ما﴾: relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُوحى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يوحى. ﴿وَضائِقٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on تارك. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضائق. ﴿صَدْرُكَ﴾: fāʿil (agent) of ضائق. ﴿أَنْ﴾: subjunctive-governing. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ﴾: a passive past verb, and كنز is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزل. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to جاء; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَلَكٌ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained particle (makfūfa). ﴿أَنْتَ نَذِيرٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وكيل. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكِيلٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿أَمْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿افْتَراهُ﴾: a past verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; its clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِعَشْرِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فأتوا. ﴿سُوَرٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِثْلِهِ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مُفْتَرَياتٍ﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَادْعُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ﴾: مَن is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective [Translator's note: so in the source; after a relative noun the clause would normally be its ṣila]. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استطعتم. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿فَإِلَّمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and in is conditional. ﴿لم﴾: jussive-governing. ﴿يَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستجيبوا; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَاعْلَمُوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَنَّما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained particle, standing in for the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِعِلْمِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنْ﴾: lightened from the heavy أنّ. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation, standing in the place of an [Translator's note: so in the source, «تحل محل أن»]. ﴿إِلهَ﴾: its noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the omitted khabar; the clause is the khabar of an. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and hal is an interrogative particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is initial. ﴿يُرِيدُ الْحَياةَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَزِينَتَها﴾: maʿṭūf on الحياة; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُوَفِّ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, by the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is an apodosis not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نوف; the two clauses of the condition are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of من. ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نوف. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبخسون. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُبْخَسُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:16-18.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿النَّارُ﴾: the postponed noun of laysa; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَحَبِطَ ما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, and the relative mā is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿صَنَعُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَباطِلٌ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and مَن is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is omitted. ﴿كانَ﴾: kāna, and its noun is omitted. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of بينة; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَتْلُوهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw because of heaviness; the hāʾ is its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿شاهِدٌ﴾: a postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شاهد. ﴿وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كِتابُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِماماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾: maʿṭūf on إماما. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنون. ﴿وَمِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is وَمَنْ]: the wāw is a conjunction, and مَن is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَكْفُرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يكفر. ﴿مِنَ الْأَحْزابِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَالنَّارُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and النار is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَوْعِدُهُ﴾: khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of من. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive (nāhiya), jussive-governing. ﴿تَكُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive with an implied sukūn on the dropped letter; its noun is omitted. ﴿فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of مرية; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الحق; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾: its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and مَن is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَظْلَمُ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾: مِن is a preposition and مَن a relative noun; the two are attached to أظلم. ﴿افْتَرى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to افترى. ﴿كَذِباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُعْرَضُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعرضون; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهادُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and أولاء is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, khabar; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كَذَبُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَلا﴾: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention. ﴿لَعْنَةُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is the object of the saying of an omitted verb of saying, its implied form being "Allah says that to the disbelievers" (يقول الله ذلك للكافرين).

daas-irab:19-24.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَصُدُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصدون, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, and the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَيَبْغُونَها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿عِوَجاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and هم is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كافرون. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative and the kāf is for address; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾: jussive-governing. ﴿يَكُونُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مُعْجِزِينَ﴾: khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to معجزين. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿كانَ لَهُمْ﴾: kāna, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: genitive in form and nominative in position, the noun of kāna; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُضاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and العذاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يضاعف, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿السَّمْعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَما كانُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, mā is negating, and kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُبْصِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address; the relative noun is the khabar. ﴿خَسِرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَضَلَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضل. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كانُوا﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of كانوا. ﴿لا جَرَمَ﴾: lā is negating, and جرم is a past verb. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun; it is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the fāʿil of جرم. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a pronoun of separation. ﴿الْأَخْسَرُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَأَخْبَتُوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿إِلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخبتوا; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾: the khabar of هم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْفَرِيقَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿كَالْأَعْمى﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَالْأَصَمِّ﴾: maʿṭūf on الأعمى. ﴿وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِيانِ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; in يستويان the fāʿil is the alif of the dual], and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and lā is negating. ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:25-28.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to an oath, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا نُوحاً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause that answers the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نذير. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of نذير; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), the implied form being "قال إني" ("he said: I …"), and the clause قال etc. is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the word in the verse is أَلَّا]: the subjunctive-governing an, and lā is prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿تَعْبُدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَخافُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخاف; the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿عَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾: an adjective. ﴿فَقالَ الْمَلَأُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, an adjective of الملأ. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما نَراكَ﴾: mā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿بَشَراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِثْلَنا﴾: an adjective, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَما نَراكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿نَراكَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the kāf is its object and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿اتَّبَعَكَ﴾: a past verb, and the kāf is its fronted object; the clause is in the position of the accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, the fāʿil of اتبعك. ﴿هُمْ أَراذِلُنا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بادِيَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to اتبعك. ﴿الرَّأْيِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿نَرى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نرى. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿نَظُنُّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كاذِبِينَ﴾: its second object, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf), accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the first person. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بينة. ﴿وَآتانِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its first object, and its fāʿil being latent. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of رحمة; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَعُمِّيَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a passive past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عميت; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوها﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb; the kāf and the hāʾ are its two objects, the wāw is a letter of vowel-lengthening (ishbāʿ), and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and أنتم is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كارهون. ﴿كارِهُونَ﴾: khabar; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:29-30.t: ﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the first person. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مالًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿أَجرِيَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance prevented by the vowel suited to it; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿أَنَا﴾: the noun of mā. ﴿بِطارِدِ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and طارد is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُلاقُوا﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar, nominative with the wāw. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنِّي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَراكُمْ﴾: a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; أراكم is an imperfect verb], its first object, and its fāʿil being latent. ﴿قَوْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿تَجْهَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of قوما. ﴿وَيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and يا is a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed, in construct, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the first person, its appearance prevented by the vowel suited to it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَنْصُرُنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by مِن; the two are attached to ينصرني; the clause is the khabar. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿طَرَدْتُهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and lā is negating. ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:31-33.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿أَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقول. ﴿عِنْدِي﴾: an adverb of place attached to the fronted khabar (predicate); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَزائِنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا أَعْلَمُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) on ولا أقول, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿الْغَيْبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا أَقُولُ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنِّي مَلَكٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَلا أَقُولُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقول. ﴿تَزْدَرِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿أَعْيُنُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil, nominative; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَنْ﴾: a subjunctive-governing particle. ﴿يُؤْتِيَهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the hāʾ is its fronted first object. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ [Translator's note: so vowelled in the source; the word in the verse is اللَّهُ]: the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿خَيْراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ and أعلم the khabar. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is relative; the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا نُوحُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and نوح is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿جادَلْتَنا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَأَكْثَرْتَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿جِدالَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأْتِنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾: mā is relative; the two are attached to ائتنا. ﴿تَعِدُنا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; نا is its object and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained particle (makfūfa). ﴿يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fronted object, and the Name of Majesty is its postponed fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يأتيكم, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿شاءَ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is initial, and the apodosis is omitted. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating of the genus, operating like laysa [Translator's note: so in the source, «نافية للجنس تعمل عمل ليس»; mā here is the ḥijāzī mā that operates like laysa]. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: the noun of mā, in the position of the nominative as the noun of mā. ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿معجزين﴾: khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

farraa:1-3.t:
His saying: ﴿الۤر كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ﴾.
You put «الكتاب» in the nominative (rafʿ) by the letters of the alphabet that precede it, as though you said: "The letters of the alphabet [are] this Qur'an." If you wish, you may imply something to make it nominative, as though you said: "Alif Lām Rā: this is the Book."
His saying ﴿ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ﴾: with the lawful and the unlawful, and the command and the prohibition. That is why His saying ﴿ألاّ تعبدوا﴾ came.
Then He said ﴿وَأَنِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمْ﴾, that is: its verses were set out in detail [to the effect] that you should not worship [other than Allah] and that you should seek forgiveness. So «أنْ» is in the position of the accusative (naṣb) because you dropped the preposition (al-khāfiḍ). «[Translator's note: the printed text reads «وأن استغفرا», evidently for «وأن استغفروا».]»

farraa:5-5.t:
His saying: ﴿أَلا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُواْ مِنْهُ﴾. It was revealed about some of those who used to meet the Prophet ﷺ with what he liked while concealing enmity and hatred towards him. That "folding" (al-thanī) is concealment. And Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said ﴿أَلا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ الله﴾ what they conceal of enmity towards Muhammad ﷺ.
(Muḥammad related to us, saying:) al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: The trustworthy ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mubārak related to me from Ibn Jurayj, from a man — I think he was ʿAṭāʾ — from Ibn ʿAbbās, that he read (تَثْنَونى صُدُورُهُمْ). In Arabic it has the sense of «تَنْثَنى» ("they fold up"), as ʿAntara said:
وقولكَ للشىء الذى لا تناله * إذا ما هو احلولى أَلا ليت ذاليا
(And your saying, of the thing you cannot attain, when it has become very sweet: "Would that that were mine!")
It is of the verb pattern «افعوعلت» (ifʿawʿaltu).

farraa:6-6.t: His saying: ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا﴾. Its «مستقرّ» is where it takes shelter by night or day. Its «مستودَع» is the place in which it dies or is buried.

farraa:7-7.t:
His saying: ﴿لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ﴾ (وسِحْر مبين). Whoever says (سَاحِرٌ مُبِينٌ) refers, in their words, to the Prophet ﷺ; whoever says (سِحْرٌ) refers to the speech. «[Translator's note: the printed text reads «ذهب إلا النبىّ», evidently for «ذهب إلى النبىّ».]»
(Muḥammad related to us, saying:) al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: Abū Isrāʾīl related to me from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Razīn, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd, that he read «ساحر» in three places: at the end of al-Māʾida, in Yūnus, and in al-Ṣaff.
al-Farrāʾ said: He did not mention the one in Hūd. Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb used to read it in four places and made this the fourth, meaning in Hūd.

farraa:11-11.t: His saying: ﴿إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ﴾ is in the position of the accusative by exception from His saying: ﴿ولَئِنْ أَذَقنَاهُ﴾, meaning man; then He made an exception from «الإنسان» because it has the sense of "people," as He, Blessed and Exalted, said: ﴿وَٱلعَصْرِ إنَّ الإنْسَانَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ إِلاَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾, so He excepted many from a singular word, because it is interpreted as a collective.

farraa:12-12.t:
His saying — Mighty and Majestic is He —: ﴿فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ﴾.
He is saying: your breast is straitened by what We reveal to you, so you do not convey it to them for fear that they say: "Why has a treasure not been sent down to you?" The «أن» in His saying ﴿أَنْ يَقُولوا﴾ is evidence of that. It is like His saying: ﴿يُبَيَّنُ اللّهُ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَضِلُّوا﴾. (مِن) would fit well in it and is then dropped, so it is in the position of the accusative, as He — Mighty and Majestic — said: ﴿يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَابِعَهُمْ فىِ آذَانِهِمْ مِنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الَموْتِ﴾. Do you not see that (مِنْ) fits well with «الحَذَر»? When it is dropped, it becomes accusative by the verb, not by the dropping of (من), as in the saying of the poet:
وأَغفرُ عوراء الكريم اصطناعَه * وأُعرِض عن ذات الّلئيم تَكَرُّماً
(I forgive the noble man's ugly word to win him over, and I turn away from the base man's [abuse] out of magnanimity.)

farraa:13-14.t: His saying: ﴿قُلْ فَأْتُواْ بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهِ مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ﴾. Then He, exalted be His mention, said: ﴿فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُواْ لَكُمْ﴾ and did not say «لك» ("to you", singular), though He had said at the beginning of the speech (قُلْ) and not «قولوا» ("say", plural). It is like His saying: ﴿عَلَى خَوْفٍ مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِمْ﴾.

farraa:15-15.t:
His saying: ﴿مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا﴾, then He said: (نُوَفِّ) [in the jussive], because the meaning lies in what comes after «كان». «كان» may be void in meaning, for a speaker says: «إن كنت تعطينى سألتك» ("if you would give me, I would ask you"), and it is like your saying: «إن أعطيتنى سألتك» ("if you give me, I will ask you"). Most often the condition (jazāʾ) comes such that it and its apodosis (jawāb) agree [in form]. If you say: «إن تفعل أَفعل», that is good. If you say: «إن فعلتَ أفعلْ», it is considered permissible. The [normal] speech is «إن فعلتَ فعلتُ». Zuhayr said, in permitting it:
ومن هاب أسباب المنايا ينلْنَه * ولو نال أسباب السمّاء بسُلّم
(Whoever fears the causes of death, they will reach him, even if he reached the tracts of the sky by a ladder.)
His saying: ﴿وَهُمْ فِيهَا لاَ يُبْخَسُونَ﴾. He is saying: whoever of the people of the qibla wants by his deeds the reward of this world, his reward is hastened for him and he is not shortchanged (lam yubkhas), that is, not diminished, in this world.

farraa:17-17.t:
His saying: ﴿أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ﴾ (The one upon clear evidence from his Lord is Muhammad ﷺ. «ويتلوه شاهد منه») means Gabriel (peace be upon him) recites the Qur'an; the hāʾ [of «يتلوه»] refers to the Qur'an. The explanation of that is: and a witness from Allah recites the Qur'an. ﴿وَمِن قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسَىٰ﴾: you put «الكتاب» in the nominative by «مِن». Or you could put it in the accusative, as in: "and he recites, before it, the Book of Moses." (إمَاماً) is accusative by qaṭʿ (detachment, i.e. as ḥāl) from (كتاب موسى) in both cases. It has also been said of His saying ﴿وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ﴾: it means the Gospel follows the Qur'an, even though it was sent down before it; he takes it to mean that it follows it by confirming it. Then He said: and before the Gospel, the Book of Moses. «[Translator's note: the sentence beginning "Or you could put it in the accusative" has no completing clause in the source; it is translated as written.]»
No explicit apodosis (jawāb) came for His saying ﴿أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ﴾, as in His saying in the Sūra of Muhammad ﷺ: ﴿أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ كَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ﴾. The Arabs sometimes leave out the answer of a thing whose meaning is known, even though the answer is omitted. The poet said:
فأُقسم لو شَىْ أتانا رَسولُه * سِوَاك ولكن لم نجد لكَ مَدْفَعا
(I swear, if anything other than you had sent its messenger to us — but we found no way of repelling you.)
And Allah, Blessed and Exalted — and He is more truthful than the words of the poet — said: ﴿وَلَوْ أَنُّ قُرْآناً سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطَّعَتْ بِهِ الأرْضُ﴾, and no answer was given for it, and Allah knows best. Some grammarians explain it, meaning that its answer is: (وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ وَلَوْ أَنَّ قرآناً); but the first is closer to correct.
