muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿ويا قوم من ينصرني من الله إن طردتهم أفلا تذكرون﴾: conjoined to what precedes it; من is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ينصرني is the khabar; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينصرني﴾; إن is conditional; طردتهم is the protasis, and it is a past verb, an agent and a direct object; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. then who would help me; ﴿أفلا تذكرون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, and it either enters upon something implied, its implied form being: «أتأمروني بطردهم فلا تذكرون» ("do you order me to drive them away, and so do you not take heed?"), or it is brought forward from a later position, the original being: «فألا تذكرون», the hamza having been placed before the fāʾ because it has the right to the front of the clause (al-ṣadāra); and تذكرون is an imperfect verb.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿قال يا قوم أرهطي أعز عليكم من الله﴾: the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation; رهطي is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أعز is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عليكم﴾ and ﴿من الله﴾ are each a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعز﴾.
﴿واتخذتموه وراءكم ظهريا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) with قد implied, i.e. "while you have taken him behind you"; اتخذ takes two objects, the first of which is the hā' and the second ظهريًّا; ﴿وراءكم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿اتخذتموه﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ظهريًّا. Or اتخذ takes a single object, the hā' being its object and ظهريًّا a ḥāl. The wāw in اتخذتموه is for lengthening (ishbāʿ) the ḍamma of the mīm.
﴿إن ربي بما تعملون محيط﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ربي is its noun; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿محيط﴾; the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; and محيط is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿ويا قوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إني عامل﴾: اعملوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); على مكانتكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while you are characterised by high standing and far-reaching power"; إن is an abrogating particle, the yā' is its noun, and عامل is its khabar (predicate).
﴿سوف تعلمون من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه ومن هو كاذب﴾: سوف is a particle of futurity; تعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the clause is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), a clause with no grammatical position; من is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تعلمون﴾; the clause يأتيه is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; the hā' is the object of يأتي, and عذاب is the fāʿil (agent) of يأتي; the clause يخزيه is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عذاب﴾; and من is a relative noun conjoined to the first one; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and كاذب the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿هو كاذب﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وارتقبوا إني معكم رقيب﴾: ﴿وارتقبوا﴾ is conjoined according to the sense; ارتقبوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); إن is an abrogating particle, the yā' is its noun; معكم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿رقيب﴾; and رقيب is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿ولما جاء أمرنا نجينا شعيبا والذين آمنوا معه برحمة منا﴾: لما is temporal ("at the time when"), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نجينا﴾, or it is a linking particle (rābiṭa); جاء أمرنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); نجينا شعيبا is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is conjoined to ﴿شعيبا﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; معه is an adverb of place attached to ﴿آمنوا﴾; برحمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجينا﴾; and منا is an adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة.
﴿وأخذت الذين ظلموا الصيحة﴾: الذين is an object placed first, of ﴿أخذت﴾; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and الصيحة is the fāʿil (agent) of أخذت.
﴿فأصبحوا في ديارهم جاثمين﴾: أصبحوا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters); the wāw is its noun, and جاثمين is its khabar (predicate); في ديارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاثمين﴾.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿كأن لم يغنوا فيها ألا بعدا لمدين كما بعدت ثمود﴾: كأن is lightened (mukhaffafa), its noun is omitted, and the clause ﴿لم يغنوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغنوا﴾; ألا is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); ﴿بعدا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. بعدوا بعدا, so it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) carrying the sense of an imprecation against them. ﴿لمدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بعدا﴾. ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿بعدًا﴾, i.e. "a perishing for Madyan like the perishing of Thamūd"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿بعدت ثمود﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿بعدت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿بعدت﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:96-96.t: ﴿ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا وسلطان مبين﴾: بآياتنا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while he was furnished with Our signs"; سلطان is conjoined to ﴿آياتنا﴾; and ﴿مبين﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿إلى فرعون وملئه فاتبعوا أمر فرعون﴾: إلى فرعون is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; ملئه is conjoined to فرعون; فاتبعوا is conjoined to أرسلنا, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); and أمر فرعون is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وما أمر فرعون برشيد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿أمر﴾ is the noun of mā, and ﴿فرعون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿برشيد﴾: the bā' is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿رشيد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive (majrūr) in form because of the bā'.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t: ﴿يقدم قومه يوم القيامة فأوردهم النار وبئس الورد المورود﴾: the clause يقدم قومه is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position; the fā' is conjunctive; أوردهم النار is a verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); the hā' is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and النار the second; بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; الورد is the fāʿil of بئس, nominative, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "the place of watering"; ﴿المورود﴾ is the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm), and it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو, or it is a mubtadaʾ placed after, with the clause ﴿بئس﴾ as its khabar.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿وأتبعوا في هذه لعنة ويوم القيامة بئس الرفد المرفود﴾: أتبعوا is a past verb in the passive form (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿في هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أتبعوا﴾; يوم القيامة is conjoined to the position of ﴿في هذه﴾; بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; الرفد is the fāʿil (agent) of بئس, nominative, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "the place of the gift"; ﴿المرفود﴾ is the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm), and it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو, or a mubtadaʾ placed after, with the clause بئس as its khabar.
[Translator's note: the source text does not parse لعنة.]

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿ذلك من أنباء القرى نقصه عليك منها قائم وحصيد﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); من أنباء القرى is its first khabar (predicate); the clause نقصه is its second khabar; عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقصه﴾; ﴿منها﴾ is a khabar placed first; قائم is the mubtadaʾ; حصيد is conjoined to قائم; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿وما ظلمناهم ولكن ظلموا أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; ظلمناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لكن is inoperative (muhmala), for rectification (istidrāk); and ظلموا أنفسهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فما أغنت عنهم آلهتهم التي يدعون من دون الله من شيء﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; ما is negating; أغنت is a past verb; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أغنت﴾; آلهتهم is the fāʿil (agent); التي is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause يدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; من دون الله is a ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a redundant (ṣila) particle; and شيء is genitive in form and accusative in position, as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿لما جاء أمر ربك وما زادوهم غير تتبيب﴾: لما is temporal ("at the time when"), attached to ﴿أغنت﴾, or it is a linking particle (rābiṭa); جاء أمر ربك is a verb and its fāʿil; ما زادوهم is conjoined to ما أغنت; زادوهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and غير تتبيب is a second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿وكذلك أخذ ربك إذا أخذ القرى وهي ظالمة﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as a khabar (predicate) placed first; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أخذ﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, and ﴿ربك﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿إذا أخذ القرى﴾: إذا is an adverb of future time, and the clause أخذ القرى is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and ظالمة the khabar, and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the apodosis (jawāb) of إذا, which is what puts it in the accusative, is omitted, the implied form being: "then nothing will avail them against His seizing."
﴿إن أخذه أليم شديد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); أخذه is its noun; and أليم شديد are its two khabars (predicates).

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لمن خاف عذاب الآخرة﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; في ذلك is its khabar (predicate) placed first; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is its noun placed after; ﴿لمن﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of آية; and the clause ﴿خاف عذاب الآخرة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك يوم مجموع له الناس وذلك يوم مشهود﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); يوم is the khabar; مجموع is an adjective; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) مجموع; الناس is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ذلك يوم مشهود is conjoined to what precedes; and a preposition with its genitive noun must be supposed, i.e. مشهود فيه ("witnessed in it").

muyesser-irab:104-104.t: ﴿وما نؤخره إلا لأجل معدود﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ما is negating; نؤخره is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); لأجل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نؤخره﴾; and معدود is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿يوم يأت لا تكلم نفس إلا بإذنه﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying ﴿لا تكلم﴾, i.e. "it will not speak on that very day"; the clause يأتي is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the fāʿil (agent) of يأتي is a pronoun referring to that day mentioned before, or the fāʿil of يأتي is Allah, Mighty and Majestic, because the pronoun in ﴿بإذنه﴾ refers to Him; لا is negating; تكلم is an imperfect verb, and نفس is the fāʿil of تكلم; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and بإذنه is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فمنهم شقي وسعيد﴾: the fā' is for subdivision (tafrīʿ); منهم is a khabar (predicate) placed first; شقي is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; and سعيد is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "and among them is one who is happy".

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿فأما الذين شقوا ففي النار﴾: the fā' is likewise for subdivision (tafrīʿ); أما is a particle of condition and detailing; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause شقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; the fā' is linking (rābiṭa); and في النار is the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿لهم فيها زفير وشهيق﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar placed first; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of زفير, or attached to the khabar placed first; زفير is a mubtadaʾ placed after; and شهيق is conjoined to زفير, nominative.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿خالدين فيها ما دامت السماوات والأرض﴾: خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الذين شقوا; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدين﴾; ﴿ما دامت السماوات﴾: ما is temporal-maṣdariyya; دامت is here complete (tāmma), because it means "remained"; السماوات is the fāʿil (agent) of دامت; and الأرض is conjoined.
﴿إلا ما شاء ربك﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; ما is the excepted; and the clause شاء ربك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن ربك فعال لما يريد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; ربك is its noun; فعال is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿فعال﴾; and the clause يريد is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿وأما الذين سعدوا ففي الجنة خالدين فيها ما دامت السماوات والأرض إلا ما شاء ربك﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أما is a particle of condition and detailing; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause سعدوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; the fā' is linking (rābiṭa); في الجنة is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الذين سعدوا; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدين﴾; ﴿ما دامت السماوات﴾: ما is temporal-maṣdariyya; دامت is here complete (tāmma) because it means "remained"; السماوات is the fāʿil (agent) of دامت; الأرض is conjoined; إلا is a particle of exception; ما is the excepted; and the clause شاء ربك is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿عطاء غير مجذوذ﴾: عطاء is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) confirming the sense of the clause before it, because His saying ﴿ففي الجنة خالدين فيها﴾ entails giving and bestowing favour; and غير مجذوذ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عطاء﴾.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ولا أقول لكم عندي خزائن الله ولا أعلم الغيب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negative; أقول is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أقول﴾; ﴿عندي﴾ is an adverb of place attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); خزائن الله is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and لا أعلم الغيب is conjoined to ﴿لا أقول﴾.
﴿ولا أقول إني ملك﴾: also conjoined to the first ﴿لا أقول﴾; إنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ملك is its khabar; and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said).
﴿ولا أقول للذين تزدري أعينكم لن يؤتيهم الله خيرا﴾: also conjoined; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أقول﴾; the clause تزدري أعينكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; لن is a particle of negation, accusative and future; يؤتيهم is accusative (manṣūb) by it; the hāʾ is the first object of يؤتي; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); and خيرًا is the second object of ﴿يؤتي﴾.
﴿الله أعلم بما في أنفسهم إني إذا لمن الظالمين﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and أعلم is the khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿في أنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿من الظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قالوا يا نوح قد جادلتنا فأكثرت جدالنا﴾: ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its agent; يا is a vocative particle, and نوح is a vocative (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); جادلتنا is a verb, its agent and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فأكثرت is conjoined to ﴿جادلتنا﴾; and جدالنا is the direct object.
﴿فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause تعدنا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; or ما is maṣdar-forming, i.e. with your promise to us; ﴿إن كنت من الصادقين﴾ is a condition whose apodosis is indicated by what precedes it, i.e. then bring us [it]; and من الصادقين is the khabar of كنت.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قال إنما يأتيكم به الله إن شاء وما أنتم بمعجزين﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يأتيكم is an imperfect verb and its direct object; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتيكم﴾; ﴿الله﴾ is the agent; ﴿إن شاء﴾ is a condition and its verb, and the apodosis is omitted; ﴿وما﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (ḥāliyya, circumstantial); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] which operates like ليس; ﴿أنتم﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بمعجزين﴾: the bāʾ is an extra (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿معجزين﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in wording.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولا ينفعكم نصحي إن أردت أن أنصح لكم إن كان الله يريد أن يغويكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negative; ينفعكم نصحي is a verb, a direct object and an agent; ﴿إن أردت﴾ is a condition and its verb; أن together with what falls in its scope is the object of أردت; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنصح﴾; ﴿إن كان﴾ is likewise a condition and its verb; ﴿الله﴾ is the noun of كان; the clause يريد is the khabar of كان; and ﴿أن يغويكم﴾: أن together with what falls in its scope is the object of يريد.
﴿هو ربكم وإليه ترجعون﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ, and ربكم is the khabar; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾; ترجعون is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿أم يقولون افتراه﴾: أم is a disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction, so it has the meaning of بل together with the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: «بل أيقولون افتراه» ("rather, do they say he invented it?"), the hamza being for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); or ﴿أم﴾ is connected (muttaṣila), and in that case a clause must be implied so that the balance [between the two alternatives] is correct, the implied form being: «أيقرون به أم يقولون: افتراه؟» ("do they acknowledge it, or do they say: he invented it?"); the clause ﴿افتراه﴾ is what is said. ﴿يقولون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn.
﴿قل إن افتريته فعلي إجرامي وأنا بريء مما تجرمون﴾: إن is conditional; افتريته is a verb, its agent and its direct object, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); علي is a fronted khabar, and إجرامي is a postponed mubtadaʾ; أنا is a mubtadaʾ, and بريء is the khabar; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بريء﴾; and the clause تجرمون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿وأوحي إلى نوح أنه لن يؤمن من قومك إلا من قد آمن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أوحي is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; أنّ together with what falls in its scope is the deputy agent; the clause ﴿لن يؤمن﴾ is the khabar of أنّ; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); ﴿مَن﴾ is the agent of يؤمن; and the clause قد آمن is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا تبتئس بما كانوا يفعلون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تبتئس is jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبتئس﴾; the clause كانوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause يفعلون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿واصنع الفلك بأعيننا ووحينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اصنع is conjoined to what precedes; الفلك is the direct object; بأعيننا is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. guarded by Our eyes; and وحينا is conjoined to أعيننا.
﴿ولا تخاطبني في الذين ظلموا إنهم مغرقون﴾: لا is prohibitive, and تخاطبني is jussive by it; the yāʾ is the direct object; ﴿في الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تخاطبني﴾; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿إنهم مغرقون﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and مغرقون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ويصنع الفلك وكلما مر عليه ملأ من قومه سخروا منه﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); الفلك is the direct object; ﴿وكلما﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl; ﴿كلَّ﴾ is a deputy of an adverb of time (nāʾib ẓarf zamān), attached to ﴿سخروا﴾, and it carries the meaning of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming and temporal (maṣdariyya zamāniyya); the clause ﴿مر﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive as the second term of the construct, the implied form being: «كلَّ مرور» ("every passing"), and that is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «كلَّ وقتِ مرورِ ملأ» ("every time of the passing of a group of chiefs"). Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite qualified [by an adjective] (nakira mawṣūfa) with the meaning of ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), the returning pronoun being omitted, the implied form being: «كلَّ وقتٍ مر فيه ملأ» ("every time in which a group passed"), so the clause ﴿مر﴾ is in the position of a genitive as an adjective of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿مر﴾ is a past verb; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مرّ﴾; ﴿ملأ﴾ is the agent; ﴿من قومه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ملأ﴾; and the clause ﴿سخروا منه﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿قال إن تسخروا منا فإنا نسخر منكم كما تسخرون﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; إن is conditional; تسخروا is the protasis; منا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسخروا﴾; the fāʾ is linking; ﴿إنّا﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause نسخر منكم is the khabar of إنّ; ﴿كما تسخرون﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: «نسخر منكم سخريةً مثلَ سخريتكم» ("we mock you with a mockery like your mockery"); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming; ﴿تسخرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the agent; the clause ﴿تسخرون﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ and the imperfect verb is the muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿فسوف تعلمون من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; سوف is a particle of the future; تعلمون is an imperfect verb and its agent; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative [noun] in the position of an accusative by ﴿تعلمون﴾, and تعلمون has the sense of recognising (ʿirfān), so it takes one object in the accusative; or ﴿مَن﴾ is interrogative, a direct object; or تعلمون is [a verb] of certainty, and the second object is omitted; ﴿يأتيه﴾ is a verb and its direct object; عذاب is the agent; and the clause يخزيه is an adjective of عذاب.
﴿ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يحل is conjoined to يأتيه; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحل﴾; عذاب is the agent; and مقيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿حتى إذا جاء أمرنا وفار التنور﴾: حتى is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. It is attached to His saying ﴿واصنع الفلك بأعيننا﴾, i.e. until this time, so it is a particle of termination and a preposition [Translator's note: so in the source, which calls حتى both inceptive and a genitive-governing particle of termination]; إذا is an adverb for future time; the clause ﴿جاء أمرنا﴾ is in the position of a genitive as the second term of a construct (bi-l-iḍāfa); and the clause ﴿وفار التنور﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿جاء أمرنا﴾.
﴿قلنا احمل فيها من كل زوجين اثنين﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to ﴿إذا﴾; احمل is an imperative verb; فيها is attached to ﴿احمل﴾; ﴿من كل﴾ is a ḥāl of ﴿زوجين﴾; زوجين is the direct object; and اثنين is an adjective for emphasis and reinforcement.
﴿وأهلك إلا من سبق عليه القول﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أهلك is conjoined to زوجين; إلا is a particle of exception; من is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil); and the clause سبق عليه القول is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن آمن وما آمن معه إلا قليل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من آمن is conjoined to ﴿أهلك﴾; ﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative; آمن is a past verb; معه is an adverb attached to ﴿آمن﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction; and قليل is the agent of آمن.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وقال اركبوا فيها بسم الله مجراها ومرساها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قال is a past verb; the clause اركبوا فيها is what is said; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اركبوا﴾; باسم الله is a fronted khabar, and مجراها is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a ḥāl of the wāw in ﴿اركبوا﴾, i.e. embark in it naming Allah, or of the hāʾ in ﴿فيها﴾, i.e. saying: In the name of Allah; and مرساها is conjoined to مجراها.
﴿إن ربي لغفور رحيم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ربي is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām; غفور is the first khabar of إنّ, and رحيم is the second khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وهي تجري بهم في موج كالجبال﴾: a ḥāl of something omitted, i.e. so they embarked in it, the situation being that it was sailing with them; or resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿تجري﴾ is the khabar; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿في موج﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; ﴿كالجبال﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a genitive as an adjective of موج, and ﴿الجبال﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ونادى نوح ابنه وكان في معزل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نادى نوح ابنه is a verb, an agent and an object; ﴿وكان﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and its noun is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to the son; and في معزل is the khabar of كان.
﴿يا بني اركب معنا ولا تكن مع الكافرين﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and بني is a vocative put in construct with the yāʾ of the first person; اركب is an imperative verb; معنا is an adverb attached to ﴿اركب﴾; لا is prohibitive; تكن is a defective imperfect verb made jussive by لا, and its noun is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); and مع الكافرين is an adverb attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿قال سآوي إلى جبل يعصمني من الماء﴾: the clause سآوي is what is said; إلى جبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آوي﴾; the clause يعصمني is an adjective of جبل; and من الماء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعصمني﴾.
﴿قال لا عاصم اليوم من أمر الله إلا من رحم﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, and عاصم is its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa; ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿أمر الله﴾, because it has the meaning of a maṣdar; or the khabar of ﴿لا﴾ is omitted, and ﴿اليوم﴾ is accusative by an implied verb indicated by عاصم, i.e. there is no protector who protects today from the command of Allah, and ﴿من أمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to that omitted verb; [otherwise] من أمر الله is the khabar of ﴿لا﴾; إلا is a particle of exception or restriction; the exception is connected (muttaṣil), ﴿مَن﴾ is the excepted, and the clause رحم is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; or the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), ﴿إلا﴾ having the meaning of لكن, مَن being a mubtadaʾ, the clause رحم being the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾ with no grammatical position, and the khabar being omitted, its implied form being: «هو المعصوم» ("he is the one protected"). It has also been said: in ﴿لا عاصم اليوم﴾ there are three views:
The first: that it is an active participle in its proper sense; on this [view], His saying ﴿إلا من رحم﴾ admits two views: the first of them is that it is a connected exception, ﴿من رحم﴾ meaning the one who has mercy, i.e. there is no protector except Allah; the second of them is that it is disconnected.
The second: that ﴿عاصم﴾ means "protected" (maʿṣūm); on this [view] the exception is connected, i.e. except the one on whom Allah has mercy.
The third: that ﴿عاصم﴾ means "one possessing protection" (dhā ʿiṣma), and the exception is also connected. As for the khabar of ﴿لا﴾, it is not permissible that it be ﴿اليوم﴾, because an adverb of time cannot be a predicate of a concrete entity (al-jutha); rather, the khabar is ﴿من أمر الله﴾, and اليوم is governed by ﴿من أمر الله﴾; and it is not permissible that اليوم be governed by عاصم, since if that were so, it would have taken nunation. It has also been said: the possible readings here are four: there is no protector except one who has mercy; there is no one protected except one shown mercy; there is no protector except one shown mercy; and there is no one protected except one who has mercy. The first two are an exception from the same kind (min al-jins), and the last two are an exception from a different kind, so it is disconnected.
﴿وحال بينهما الموج فكان من المغرقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; حال is a past verb; بينهما is attached to ﴿حال﴾; الموج is the agent; ﴿فكان﴾ is conjoined to حال; the noun of كان is latent; and ﴿من المغرقين﴾ is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وقيل يا أرض ابلعي ماءك ويا سماء أقلعي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿قيل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; يا is a vocative particle, and أرض is a vocative, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma; ابلعي is an imperative verb, and the yāʾ is the agent; ماءك is the direct object; and ﴿يا سماء أقلعي﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يا أرض ابلعي﴾.
﴿وغيض الماء وقضي الأمر واستوت على الجودي﴾: clauses conjoined one to another.
﴿وقيل بعدا للقوم الظالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿قيل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; ﴿بعدا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «بعدوا بعدا» ("may they be far removed"), so it is a maṣdar with the meaning of invoking against them; ﴿للقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بعدا﴾ or to ﴿قيل﴾; and الظالمين is an adjective of القوم.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿ونادى نوح ربه فقال رب إن ابني من أهلي﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿نادى نوح﴾ is a verb and its agent, and ربه is the direct object; ﴿فقال﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb conjoined to نادى; رب is a vocative put in construct with the yāʾ of the first person, which has been deleted; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ابني is its noun; and ﴿من أهلي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar.
﴿وإن وعدك الحق وأنت أحكم الحاكمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إنّ is an abrogating particle; وعدك is its noun, and الحق is its khabar; ﴿أنت أحكم الحاكمين﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is likewise conjoined.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿قال يا نوح إنه ليس من أهلك﴾: قال is a past verb, and the latent pronoun is its agent; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ليس من أهلك is the khabar of إنّ; and ﴿من أهلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ليس.
﴿إنه عمل غير صالح﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; عمل is the khabar of إنّ; and غير صالح is an adjective of عمل.
﴿فلا تسألن ما ليس لك به علم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; لا is prohibitive; تسأل is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person, deleted for lightening, is the direct object; ما is the second direct object; the clause of ﴿ليس﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the noun of ليس is ﴿علم﴾; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علم﴾.
﴿إني أعظك أن تكون من الجاهلين﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause أعظك is its khabar; إن [Translator's note: so in the source, «وإن»; the particle in the āya is أن] together with what falls in its scope is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. I warn you against being, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أعظك﴾; the noun of تكون is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); and ﴿من الجاهلين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of تكون.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿قال رب إني أعوذ بك أن أسألك ما ليس لي به علم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause أعوذ is its khabar; بك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعوذ﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition; ﴿ما﴾ is the direct object; the clause ﴿ليس لي به علم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ليس is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علم﴾; and علم is the postponed noun of ليس.
﴿وإلا تغفر لي وترحمني أكن من الخاسرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional, and لا is negative; تغفر is the protasis; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; ترحمني is conjoined to ﴿تغفر﴾; أكن is a defective, abrogating imperfect verb, the apodosis, and its noun is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); and ﴿من الخاسرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿قيل يا نوح اهبط بسلام منا وبركات عليك﴾: اهبط is an imperative verb; بسلام is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the agent of ﴿اهبط﴾, i.e. accompanied by peace; ﴿منّا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سلام or to an omitted adjective of سلام; ﴿وبركات﴾ is conjoined to سلام; and عليك is an adjective.
﴿وعلى أمم ممن معك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; على أمم is conjoined to عليك; ممن is an adjective of أمم; and معك is an adverb of place, the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأمم سنمتعهم ثم يمسهم منا عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أمم is a mubtadaʾ, and it is permissible to begin with it because it is qualified, its implied form being: «وأمم ممن معك» ("and nations of those with you"); the clause سنمتعهم is its khabar; or سنمتعهم is an adjective, and what is omitted is the khabar; ثم is a conjunction for delay; يمسهم is an imperfect verb and its direct object; منا is a ḥāl, because it was [originally] an adjective of عذاب; عذاب is the agent; and أليم is a second adjective.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿تلك من أنباء الغيب نوحيها إليك﴾: تلك is the mubtadaʾ; من أنباء الغيب is the first khabar; and the clause نوحيها إليك is a second khabar.
﴿ما كنت تعلمها أنت ولا قومك من قبل هذا فاصبر إن العاقبة للمتقين﴾: a third khabar; كنت is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause تعلمها is the khabar of كنت, and ﴿ها﴾ is the direct object; أنت is an emphasis (taʾkīd) of the latent agent of تعلمها; ولا قومك is conjoined to أنت; من قبل هذا is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in نوحيها, or of the kāf in إليك; the clause ﴿إن العاقبة للمتقين﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, العاقبة is its noun, and للمتقين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; and the clause is causal.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا﴾: conjoined to the story of Noah, and the conjoined [verb] is omitted, i.e. «وأرسلنا إلى عاد» ("and We sent to ʿĀd"), so it is a conjoining of clauses, not a conjoining of single words, because of the length of the separation; أخاهم is the object of the omitted أرسلنا; and هودًا is a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: اعبدوا الله is an imperative verb, an agent and a direct object; ما is negative; لكم is a fronted khabar; من is an extra (ṣila) particle; إله is genitive in wording and nominative in position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and غيره is an adjective of إله according to its position.
﴿إن أنتم إلا مفترون﴾: إن is negative; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction; and مفترون is the khabar of أنتم.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿يا قوم لا أسألكم عليه أجرا﴾: لا is negative; أسألكم is an imperfect verb, a latent agent and the first direct object; عليه is a ḥāl; and أجرًا is the second direct object.
﴿إن أجري إلا على الذي فطرني أفلا تعقلون﴾: إن is negative; أجري is the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction; على الذي is the khabar; the clause فطرني is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction; تعقلون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿ويا قوم استغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا إليه يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا﴾: استغفروا ربكم is an imperative verb, an agent and a direct object; ثم توبوا إليه is conjoined to استغفروا; يرسل is an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); السماء is the direct object; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مدرارا﴾; and مدرارا is a ḥāl of السماء.
﴿ويزدكم قوة إلى قوتكم ولا تتولوا مجرمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يزدكم is conjoined to ﴿يرسل﴾; the kāf is the first direct object, and قوة is the second direct object; إلى قوتكم is an adjective, إلى having the meaning of مع ("with"); ﴿ولا تتولوا﴾: لا is prohibitive, and تتولوا is jussive by لا; and مجرمين is a ḥāl of the wāw.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿قالوا يا هود ما جئتنا ببينة﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and هود is a vocative, a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma; ما is negative; جئتنا is a verb, its agent and its direct object; ببينة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جئتنا﴾, the bāʾ being for making the verb transitive (taʿdiya); or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. settled with, or accompanied by, a clear proof.
﴿وما نحن بتاركي آلهتنا عن قولك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] which operates like ليس; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بتاركي﴾: the bāʾ is an extra (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿تاركي﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in wording, the nūn having been deleted for the construct; ﴿آلهتنا﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi, and the attached pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عن قولك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in تاركي, as if he said: we will not leave our gods, proceeding from your word. Or ﴿عن﴾ is for cause (taʿlīl), and ﴿عن قولك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تاركي﴾; and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وما نحن لك بمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] which operates like ليس; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مؤمنين﴾; ﴿بمؤمنين﴾: the bāʾ is an extra (ṣila) preposition, and مؤمنين is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in wording.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿إن نقول إلا اعتراك بعض آلهتنا بسوء﴾: إن is negative; نقول is an imperfect verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); إلا is a particle of restriction; the clause اعتراك is governed by ﴿نقول﴾, i.e. it is accusative by an omitted maṣdar, and that maṣdar is accusative by ﴿نقول﴾, i.e. except our saying: [one of our gods] has afflicted you; the kāf is the direct object; بعض آلهتنا is the agent; and بسوء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اعتراك﴾.
﴿قال إني أشهد الله واشهدوا أني بريء مما تشركون﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause اشهدوا is an imperative verb; أنّ with the hamza vowelled with fatḥa, together with what falls in its scope, is governed by ﴿اشهدوا﴾, or by ﴿أشهد الله﴾; أنّ is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and بريء is its khabar; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بريء﴾; the clause تشركون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, i.e. of your associating [partners].

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿من دونه فكيدوني جميعا ثم لا تنظرون﴾: من دونه is a ḥāl; ﴿فكيدوني﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; كيدوني is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the agent, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is the direct object; جميعًا is a ḥāl; ثم is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تنظرون is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; the wāw is the agent; and the yāʾ, deleted for lightening, is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿إني توكلت على الله ربي وربكم﴾: ﴿إني﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause توكلت is its khabar; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توكلت﴾; ربي is a badal or an adjective; and ربكم is conjoined to ربي.
﴿ما من دابة إلا هو آخذ بناصيتها﴾: ما is negative; من is an extra (ṣila) particle; دابة is the mubtadaʾ, and beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it is preceded by negation; إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and آخذ is the khabar; and بناصيتها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آخذ﴾.
﴿إن ربي على صراط مستقيم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ربي is its noun; ﴿على صراط﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; and مستقيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿فإن تولوا فقد أبلغتكم ما أرسلت به إليكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تولوا is an imperfect verb from which one of the two tāʾs has been deleted, the original being تتولوا, and it is the protasis, jussive by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the agent; the fāʾ is linking; قد is a particle of verification; أبلغتكم is a verb, its agent and its direct object; ما is the second direct object; the clause أرسلت is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلت﴾; and إليكم is a ḥāl.
﴿ويستخلف ربي قوما غيركم ولا تضرونه شيئا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ربي is the agent; قومًا is the direct object; غيركم is an adjective of ﴿قومًا﴾; ولا تضرونه is conjoined to يستخلف; and شيئًا stands as deputy for the absolute object, i.e. something of harm.
﴿إن ربي على كل شيء حفيظ﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ربي is its noun; على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حفيظ﴾; and حفيظ is the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿ولما جاء أمرنا نجينا هودا والذين آمنوا معه برحمة منا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; لما is adverbial and temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), attached to ﴿نجينا﴾, or linking (rābiṭa); جاء أمرنا is a verb and its agent; نجينا هودًا is a verb, its agent and its direct object; الذين is conjoined to هود; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; معه is an adverb of place attached to ﴿آمنوا﴾; برحمة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجينا﴾; and منا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of رحمة.
﴿ونجيناهم من عذاب غليظ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نجيناهم is a verb, its agent and its direct object; من عذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجيناهم﴾; and غليظ is an adjective of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وتلك عاد جحدوا بآيات ربهم وعصوا رسله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; تلك is the mubtadaʾ; عاد is a badal or an explicative apposition; the clause جحدوا is the khabar of ﴿تلك﴾; or ﴿تلك عاد﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; بآيات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جحدوا﴾; ربهم is a muḍāf [Translator's note: so in the source; ربهم is in fact the muḍāf ilayhi of آيات]; and عصوا رسله is a verb, its agent and its direct object.
﴿واتبعوا أمر كل جبار عنيد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتبعوا is conjoined to ﴿جحدوا﴾; أمر is the direct object; كل is the muḍāf ilayhi, and جبار is a muḍāf ilayhi; and عنيد is an adjective of ﴿جبار﴾.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وأتبعوا في هذه الدنيا لعنة ويوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أتبعوا is conjoined to what precedes, and it is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named, the wāw being the deputy agent; ﴿في هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتبعوا﴾; الدنيا is a badal of the demonstrative; لعنة is the second direct object; ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿أتبعوا﴾, so it is conjoined to the semi-clause (shibh al-jumla) ﴿في هذه﴾; and القيامة is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ألا إن عادا كفروا ربهم﴾: ألا is a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh); إنّ is an abrogating particle, and عادا is its noun; كفروا is a verb and its agent; ربهم is accusative by removal of the preposition, or accusative as an object by making كفروا imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of جحدوا ("they denied"); and the clause كفروا is the khabar of إنّ.
﴿ألا بعدا لعاد قوم هود﴾: ﴿ألا﴾ is a particle of drawing attention, an emphasis of the first; ﴿بعدا﴾ is an absolute object of an omitted verb, i.e. «بعدوا بعدا» ("may they be far removed"), so it is a maṣdar with the meaning of invoking against them; ﴿لعاد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بعدا﴾; ﴿قوم﴾ is a badal or an explicative apposition; and ﴿هود﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿فلا تك في مرية مما يعبد هؤلاء﴾: the fā' is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تك is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was dropped for lightness; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿في مرية﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿مرية﴾; the clause يعبد is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; هؤلاء is the fāʿil (agent); or ما is maṣdariyya.
﴿ما يعبدون إلا كما يعبد آباؤهم من قبل﴾: ما is negating; يعبدون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "except with a worship like the worship of their fathers"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿يعبد﴾ is an imperfect verb, and ﴿آباؤهم﴾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعبد﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the imperfect verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإنا لموفوهم نصيبهم غير منقوص﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); موفوهم is the khabar of إن, and the hā' is muḍāf ilayhi; نصيبهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and غير منقوص is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فاختلف فيه﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); آتينا موسى الكتاب is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فاختلف﴾: the fā' is a conjunction, and اختلف is a past verb in the passive form (built for that whose agent is not named); ﴿فيه﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لولا is the particle of "non-occurrence due to occurrence"; ﴿كلمة﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the clause سبقت is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿من ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبقت﴾; the lām is the response of لو; قضي بينهم is a past verb in the passive form, its nāʾib fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the adverb is attached to it, i.e. "the matter would have been decided between them". [Translator's note: the source says "the response of لو" here, though the particle in the verse is لولا.]
﴿وإنهم لفي شك منه مريب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating particle, and the hā' is its noun; ﴿في شك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿شك﴾; and مريب is a second adjective.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿وإن كلا لما ليوفينهم ربك أعمالهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لما is for negation, the jussive and shifting (the tense to the past), and its jussive verb has been omitted; ﴿ليوفينهم﴾: the lām is the response to the implied oath; يوفينهم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the hā' is the object; ربك is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and أعمالهم is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source does not give the i'rab of كلا, which is the noun of إن.]
﴿إنه بما يعملون خبير﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the hā' is its noun; ﴿بما يعملون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خبير﴾; and خبير is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿فاستقم كما أمرت ومن تاب معك﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); استقم is an imperative verb; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "be upright with an uprightness like that which you have been commanded", i.e. an uprightness in accordance with what you have been commanded, fulfilling it completely; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); أمرت is a past verb in the passive form (built for that whose agent is not named), and the tā' is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿أمرت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿ومَن﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and من is a relative noun conjoined to the pronoun in استقم; معك is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), the wāw being for accompaniment.
﴿ولا تطغوا إنه بما تعملون بصير﴾: لا is prohibitive; تطغوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إن is an abrogating particle, and the hā' is its noun; بما تعملون is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بصير﴾; and بصير is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿ولا تركنوا إلى الذين ظلموا فتمسكم النار﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تركنوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنوا﴾; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿فتمسَّكم﴾: the fā' is causal (sababiyya); تمسكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fā' that comes after a prohibition; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding words, i.e. "let there be no inclining, and then a touching". The kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and النار is the fāʿil.
﴿وما لكم من دون الله من أولياء ثم لا تنصرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "the Fire will touch you while you have no helper"; or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; من is a redundant (ṣila) particle; أولياء is genitive in form with the fatḥa and nominative in position, because it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; ثم is a conjunction; لا is negating; and تنصرون is a nominative imperfect verb.

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿وأقم الصلاة طرفي النهار وزلفا من الليل﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أقم is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); طرفي النهار is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), governed by ﴿أقم﴾; زلفًا is likewise accusative as an adverb governed by ﴿أقم﴾; and من الليل is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿إن الحسنات يذهبن السيئات ذلك ذكرى للذاكرين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); الحسنات is its noun; the clause يذهبن is its khabar (predicate); the nūn is the fāʿil of يذهبن; السيئات is the mafʿūl bihi; ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ذكرى is the khabar; and للذاكرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ذكرى.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t: ﴿واصبر فإن الله لا يضيع أجر المحسنين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; اصبر is conjoined to أقم; the fā' is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause لا يضيع is its khabar (predicate); and أجر المحسنين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿فلولا كان من القرون من قبلكم أولو بقية ينهون عن الفساد في الأرض﴾: the fā' is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لولا is for urging (taḥḍīḍ); كان is complete (tāmma), the meaning being: "why then was there not found, or why did there not come to be"; ﴿من القرون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كان﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent), which is ﴿أولو بقية﴾; ﴿من قبلكم﴾: من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of القرون if the al in it is for prior reference (ʿahd), or a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of it if the al in it is generic (jins), not making definite what it enters upon; the pronoun ﴿كم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿وأولو﴾ is its fāʿil, the sign of its nominative being the wāw, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; بقية is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ينهون عن الفساد is an adjective of ﴿أولو بقية﴾; and ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿الفساد﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl of الفساد. Or ﴿كان﴾ is incomplete (nāqiṣa) and abrogating (kāna and its sisters), ﴿من القرون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان, and the clause ﴿ينهون﴾ is an adjective of ﴿أولو﴾; or ﴿من القرون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of the noun of كان, the clause ينهون is its khabar placed first, and ﴿أولو بقية﴾ is its noun placed after.
﴿إلا قليلا ممن أنجينا منهم﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; قليلًا is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ); ممن is an adjective of ﴿قليلًا﴾; the clause أنجينا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿منهم﴾ is a ḥāl.
﴿واتبع الذين ظلموا ما أترفوا فيه وكانوا مجرمين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; اتبع is conjoined to something implied indicated by the context, its implied form being: "so they did not forbid corruption, and [they] followed"; الذين is the fāʿil; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أترفوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أترفوا; كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and مجرمين is its khabar; and the clause is conjoined to أترفوا.

muyesser-irab:117-117.t: ﴿وما كان ربك ليهلك القرى بظلم وأهلها مصلحون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ما is negating; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters); ربك is its noun; ﴿ليهلك﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (juḥūd); يهلك is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. "intending to destroy"; القرى is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بظلم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent); ﴿وأهلها﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), أهلها is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and مصلحون the khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl of the object, i.e. القرى.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿ولو شاء ربك لجعل الناس أمة واحدة﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لو is a conditional particle of impossibility (imtināʿ); شاء ربك is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the lām occurs in the response of لو; جعل الناس أمة is جعل and its two objects; and واحدة is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ولا يزالون مختلفين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا يزالون is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun; and مختلفين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿إلا من رحم ربك ولذلك خلقهم وتمت كلمة ربك﴾: ﴿إلا من رحم ربك﴾ is a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) in the sense of "but", its implied form being: "but whomever your Lord has had mercy on, he does not differ"; or it is excepted from the agent pronoun in يزالون; ﴿لذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقهم﴾; خلقهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and تمت كلمة ربك is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿لأملأن جهنم من الجنة والناس أجمعين﴾: لأملأن جهنم is the response to an implied oath, its implied form being: "by an oath, I will surely fill"; أملأن is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; جهنم is the mafʿūl bihi; من الجنة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أملأن﴾; and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:120-120.t:
﴿وكلا نقص عليك من أنباء الرسل ما نثبت به فؤادك﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; كلاًّ is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being: "and every narration We narrate to you", and the clause نقص عليك is in the position of an adjective (ṣifa) of His saying ﴿وكلاًّ﴾; or it is accusative as an object, the muḍāf ilayhi being omitted and the tanwīn substituted for it, its implied form being: "every report We narrate to you"; من أنباء is an adjective of ﴿كلاًّ﴾; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of ﴿كلاًّ﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, and on the first analysis of ﴿كلاًّ﴾ it is parsed as an object; and the clause نثبت به فؤادك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وجاءك في هذه الحق وموعظة وذكرى للمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; جاءك is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءك﴾; الحق is the fāʿil (agent) of جاءك; and what follows it is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:121-121.t:
﴿وقل للذين لا يؤمنون اعملوا على مكانتكم﴾: للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; اعملوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the clause being the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and على مكانتكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while you remain firm in your position".
﴿إنا عاملون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; and عاملون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:122-122.t: ﴿وانتظروا إنا منتظرون﴾: انتظروا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إنا منتظرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and منتظرون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿ولله غيب السماوات والأرض وإليه يرجع الأمر كله﴾: ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; ﴿غيب السماوات﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يرجع﴾; ﴿الأمر﴾ is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿كله﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis).
﴿فاعبده وتوكل عليه وما ربك بغافل عما تعملون﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); ﴿اعبده﴾ is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿توكل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اعبده﴾; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿توكل﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿ربك﴾ is the noun of mā; ﴿بغافل﴾: the bā' is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and غافل is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form because of the bā'; ﴿عما﴾: عن is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, i.e. "of that which you do"; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿تعملون﴾ is genitive by ﴿عن﴾, i.e. "of your doing"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿غافل﴾; and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإلى ثمود أخاهم صالحا﴾: conjoined to the preceding story, and the conjoined [verb] is omitted, i.e. «وأرسلنا إلى ثمود» ("and We sent to Thamūd"), so it is a conjoining of clauses, not a conjoining of single words, because of the length of the separation; أخاهم is the object of the omitted أرسلنا; and صالحا is a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: اعبدوا الله is an imperative verb, an agent (fāʿil) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ما is negative; لكم is a fronted khabar (predicate); من is an extra (ṣila) particle; إله is genitive in wording and nominative in position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and غيره is an adjective of إله according to its position.
﴿هو أنشأكم من الأرض واستعمركم فيها﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause أنشأكم is the khabar; من الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنشأكم﴾; and استعمركم فيها is conjoined to أنشأكم.
﴿فاستغفروه ثم توبوا إليه﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); استغفروه is an imperative verb, an agent and a direct object; ثم is a conjunction; and توبوا إليه is conjoined to استغفروه.
﴿إن ربي قريب مجيب﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ربي is its noun (ism); and قريب مجيب are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿قالوا يا صالح قد كنت فينا مرجوا قبل هذا﴾: قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); كنت is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; مرجوًّا is its khabar; ﴿فينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿قبل﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿مرجوًّا﴾; and هذا is the muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct).
﴿أتنهانا أن نعبد ما يعبد آباؤنا﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); تنهانا is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object; أن together with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿تنهانا﴾; and آباؤنا is the agent of يعبد.
﴿وإننا لفي شك مما تدعونا إليه مريب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في شك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿إننا﴾; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿شك﴾; the clause تدعونا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿نا﴾ is the object of تدعو; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تدعو﴾; and مريب is an adjective of ﴿شك﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال يا قوم أرأيتم إن كنت على بينة من ربي﴾: ﴿أرأيتم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; رأى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the agent; إن is conditional; كنت is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the noun of كان; على بينة is the khabar of كان; and من ربي is an adjective of بينة.
﴿وآتاني منه رحمة فمن ينصرني من الله إن عصيته﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتاني is conjoined to كنت; the yāʾ is the first direct object; منه is a ḥāl; رحمة is the second direct object; the fāʾ links the apodosis; من is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ; ﴿ينصرني﴾ is an imperfect verb, a latent agent and a direct object, and the clause is the khabar; the clause ﴿فمن ينصرني﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb) of إن; the second إن is conditional, عصيته is its verb, and its apodosis is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the first, i.e. then who would help me; the interrogation here means negation, as if he said: then there is no helper for me against Allah if I disobey Him.
﴿فما تزيدونني غير تخسير﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ما is negative; تزيدونني is an imperfect verb, an agent and a direct object; and غير is the second object of ﴿تزيدونني﴾.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿ويا قوم هذه ناقة الله لكم آية﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هذه is the mubtadaʾ, and ناقة الله is the khabar; لكم is a ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of ﴿آية﴾; آية is a ḥāl of ناقة الله, and what governs it is the verbal meaning conveyed by the demonstrative.
﴿فذروها تأكل في أرض الله﴾: ﴿فذروها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ذروها is an imperative verb and its direct object; تأكل is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), jussive (majzūm); and في أرض الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكل﴾.
﴿ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب قريب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا تمسوها is conjoined to what precedes; لا is prohibitive; تمسوها is jussive by لا, the wāw is the agent, and ﴿ها﴾ is the direct object; بسوء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تمسوها﴾; the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); the kāf is the direct object; عذاب is the agent; and قريب is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿فعقروها فقال تمتعوا في داركم ثلاثة أيام﴾: ﴿فعقروها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and عقروها is a past verb, an agent and a direct object; ﴿فقال﴾ is conjoined to عقروها; the clause تمتعوا, consisting of the imperative verb and the agent, is what is said (maqūl al-qawl); في داركم is a ḥāl; and ثلاثة أيام is an adverb attached to ﴿تمتعوا﴾.
﴿ذلك وعد غير مكذوب﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ; وعد is the khabar; and غير مكذوب is its adjective.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿فلما جاء أمرنا نجينا صالحا والذين آمنوا معه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); جاء أمرنا is a verb and its agent; نجينا صالحًا is a verb, an agent and a direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position; الذين is conjoined to ﴿صالحًا﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and معه is an adverb of place attached to ﴿آمنوا﴾.
﴿برحمة منا ومن خزي يومئذ﴾: برحمة is a ḥāl, i.e. bound up with mercy; منا is an adjective; ومن خزي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted that is indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «ونجيناهم من خزي» ("and We saved them from disgrace"); ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is a muḍāf ilayhi, and إذٍ is a noun indeclinable on an implied sukūn, because the place [of the sukūn] is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the nunation is a compensation for an omitted clause, the implied form being: «يوم إذ جاء أمرنا» ("the day when Our command came").
﴿إن ربك هو القوي العزيز﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ربك is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) or a mubtadaʾ; and القوي العزيز are two khabars of ﴿إن﴾, or of ﴿هو﴾, the clause [then] being the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿وأخذ الذين ظلموا الصيحة فأصبحوا في ديارهم جاثمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أخذ﴾ is a past verb; الذين is the direct object; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; الصيحة is the agent; فأصبحوا is conjoined to أخذ; the wāw is the noun of أصبح, and جاثمين is its khabar; and في ديارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاثمين﴾.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿كأن لم يغنوا فيها﴾: كأن is lightened from the heavy [كأنّ] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun is latent, i.e. «كأنهم» ("as if they"); the clause لم يغنوا is its khabar; and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغنوا﴾.
﴿ألا إن ثمود كفروا ربهم﴾: ألا is a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh); إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ثمود is its noun; كفروا is a verb and its agent; and ربهم is accusative by removal of the preposition, or its accusative is as an object, by making كفروا imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of جحدوا ("they denied").
﴿ألا بعدًا لثمود﴾: ألا is a particle of drawing attention, an emphasis of the first; بعدًا is accusative as a maṣdar by an implied verb, i.e. «وقيل: بعدوا بعدًا» ("and it was said: may they be far removed"), so it is a maṣdar with the meaning of invoking against them; and ﴿لثمود﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿ولقد جاءت رسلنا إبراهيم بالبشرى﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of verification; جاءت رسلنا is a verb and its agent; إبراهيم is the direct object; and بالبشرى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءت﴾.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its agent.
﴿سلامًا﴾: a direct object, or a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object), i.e. «نسلِّم سلاما» ("we greet with a greeting of peace").
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿سلام﴾: a mubtadaʾ; beginning with it is permissible although it is indefinite because it contains the meaning of supplication; and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being: «سلام عليكم» ("peace be upon you").
﴿فما لبث أن جاء بعجل حنيذ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ما لبث﴾: ما is negative, and لبث is a past verb whose agent is أن together with what falls in its scope, i.e. his coming; or the agent is latent, its implied form being إبراهيم, and إن [Translator's note: so in the source, «وإن»; the particle in the āya is أن] together with what falls in its scope is its khabar, the implied form being: «فلبثه أو الذي لبثه قدر مجيئه» ("his tarrying, or that which he tarried, was the length of his coming").

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿فلما رأى أيديهم لا تصل إليه نكرهم وأوجس منهم خيفة﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, the implied form being: «فقربه إليهم فلم يمدوا أيديهم فقال: ألا تأكلون؟» ("so he brought it near them, and they did not stretch out their hands, and he said: will you not eat?"); ﴿فلما رأى أيديهم﴾: the seeing here is visual (baṣariyya), and أيديهم is the direct object; the clause لا تصل إليه is a ḥāl; the clause ﴿نكرهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to ﴿لما﴾; أوجس منهم is conjoined to نكرهم; خيفة is the direct object; and منهم is a ḥāl, because it was [originally] an adjective of ﴿خيفة﴾.
﴿قالوا لا تخف إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم لوط﴾: ﴿لا تخف﴾: لا is prohibitive, and تخف is jussive by it; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause أرسلنا is its khabar, and ﴿نا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and إلى قوم لوط is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿وامرأته قائمة فضحكت فبشرناها بإسحاق ومن وراء إسحاق يعقوب﴾: ﴿وامرأته﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (ḥāliyya), or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; امرأته is the mubtadaʾ, and قائمة is the khabar; فضحكت is a past verb, and its agent is "she" (هي); فبشرناها is also conjoined, and it is a verb, its agent and its direct object; بإسحاق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بشرناها﴾; ومن وراء إسحاق is a fronted khabar; and يعقوب is a postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿قالت يا ويلتى أألد وأنا عجوز﴾: يا ويلتا is an expression said in wonder at an extraordinary matter that breaks with the usual, whether good or bad; it is a vocative put in construct with the yāʾ of the first person, which has been changed into an alif; ﴿أألد﴾: the interrogation is intended to express wonder; ﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl; ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and عجوز is the khabar; and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl of the latent pronoun in أألد.
﴿وهذا بعلي شيخا﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl; هذا is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿بعلي﴾ is the khabar; شيخًا is a ḥāl, and what governs it is the verbal meaning in the demonstrative.
﴿إن هذا لشيء عجيب﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and هذا is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām; شيء is its khabar; and عجيب is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿قالوا أتعجبين من أمر الله﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; تعجبين is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the yāʾ is the agent; and من أمر الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعجبين﴾.
﴿رحمت الله وبركاته عليكم أهل البيت﴾: رحمة الله is the mubtadaʾ; بركاته is conjoined to رحمة; عليكم is the khabar of رحمة; and أهل البيت is accusative by specialization (al-ikhtiṣāṣ), intended as praise, or it is a vocative from which the vocative particle has been omitted, i.e. «يا أهل البيت» ("O people of the house").
﴿إنه حميد مجيد﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; and حميد مجيد are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿فلما ذهب عن إبراهيم الروع وجاءته البشرى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal or linking; ذهب عن إبراهيم الروع is a verb and its agent; جاءته البشرى is conjoined to ذهب; and the answer of ﴿لما﴾ is omitted, its implied form being: «أقبل» ("he turned [to]"), or «فطن لمجادلتهم» ("he set about disputing with them").
﴿يجادلنا في قوم لوط﴾: the clause يجادلنا is a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position; and في قوم لوط is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجادلنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿إن إبراهيم لحليم أواه منيب﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and إبراهيم is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām; and حليم, أواه and منيب are three khabars.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿يا إبراهيم أعرض عن هذا﴾: the clause is what is said by an omitted [verb of] saying, i.e. the angels said; أعرض is an imperative verb; and عن هذا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it.
﴿إنه قد جاء أمر ربك وإنهم آتيهم عذاب غير مردود﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause قد جاء أمر ربك is the khabar; ﴿إنهم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; آتيهم is its khabar; عذاب is the agent of آتيهم; غير is an adjective; and مردود is the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿ولما جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا﴾: لما is adverbial and temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or linking; جاءت رسلنا لوطًا is a verb, an agent and a direct object; the clause سيء بهم has no grammatical position, and the deputy agent refers back to Lūṭ; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; and ذرعًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the agent.
﴿وقال هذا يوم عصيب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قال is conjoined to ﴿ضاق﴾; ﴿هذا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; يوم is the khabar; عصيب is an adjective; and the clause is what is said.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿وجاءه قومه يهرعون إليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جاءه قومه is a verb, a direct object and an agent; the clause يهرعون is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl; and إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهرعون﴾.
﴿ومن قبل كانوا يعملون السيئات﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl; ﴿من قبل﴾: من is a preposition, and قبل is an adverb indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from the construct in wording but not in meaning; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يعملون﴾; كانوا is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun; and the clause يعملون السيئات is the khabar of كانوا.
﴿قال يا قوم هؤلاء بناتي هن أطهر لكم﴾: هؤلاء is the mubtadaʾ, and بناتي is the khabar, and likewise His saying ﴿هن أطهر لكم﴾ [is a khabar]; [or] ﴿بناتي﴾ is a badal or an explicative apposition, ﴿هن﴾ is a pronoun of separation with no grammatical position, and أطهر is the khabar of هؤلاء; and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أطهر﴾, because it is an elative (ism tafḍīl).
﴿فاتقوا الله ولا تخزون في ضيفي﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتقوا الله is an imperative verb, an agent and a direct object; لا تخزوني is conjoined to اتقوا الله; لا is prohibitive; تخزوني is jussive by لا, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); the wāw is the agent, and the yāʾ is the direct object; and في ضيفي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أليس منكم رجل رشيد﴾: the interrogation is for disapproval and rebuke; ليس is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ليس; رجل is its postponed noun; and رشيد is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿قالوا لقد علمت ما لنا في بناتك من حق﴾: علمت is suspended (muʿallaqa) from governing by the negative ﴿ما﴾; لنا is a fronted khabar; في بناتك is a ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of ﴿حق﴾; من is an extra (ṣila) particle; and حق is a postponed mubtadaʾ in position.
﴿وإنك لتعلم ما نريد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the kāf is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām; the clause تعلم is its khabar; and ما is maṣdar-forming or relative, i.e. you know our wish, or you know what we want.
